note: NDMSBA is an autosomal recessive condition caused by biallelic (homozygous or compound heterozygous) PLAA mutations resulting in severe neurodevelopmental arrest and microcephaly without sex predilection.

evidence.text: Seven patients presenting at ages 2 to 4 months with progressive microcephaly, spastic quadriparesis, and global developmental delay were identified with homozygous loss-of-function variants in PLAA.

source.title: Phospholipase A2-activating protein is associated with a novel form of leukoencephalopathy
source.quote: Herein, we have identified a unique form of leukoencephalopathy in seven patients presenting at ages 2 to 4 months with progressive microcephaly, spastic quadriparesis, and global developmental delay.

evidence.text: NDMSBA (OMIM #617527) is documented as a rare autosomal recessive genetic condition associated with mutated PLAA.

source.title: Neurodevelopmental disorder with progressive microcephaly, spasticity, and brain anomalies in China caused by novel mutations of PLAA.
source.quote: disorder with progressive microcephaly, spasticity, and brain anomalies (NDMSBA; OMIM #617527) is a rare autosomal recessive genetic condition associated with mutated PLAA
